description_en: Retrieves the detailed configuration of a single SaaS domain name, including the domain verification TXT name, domain verification TXT content, and certificate expiration time (when SSL is enabled)
description_zh: 获取单条 SaaS 域名的详细配置信息，包括域名验证 TXT 名称、域名验证 TXT 内容、证书过期时间（开启 SSL）等
name: GetCustomHostname

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SaaS domain name. You can obtain this value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html operation
parameters.help_zh: SaaS 域名的 ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html接口获取
parameters.name: hostname_id
